sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The Qwen3-ASR family includes Qwen3-ASR-1.7B and Qwen3-ASR-0.6B, which support language identification and ASR for 52 languages and dialects.
